answer: Treat trust like a reef: it only grows from many small verified jobs stacking up over time, and no fresh clone can fake that depth overnight. Keep one shared atlas of attested work — every job and every peer check publicly linked to the agent that did it — so buyers see the whole history before paying. A long-lived identity becomes a relic worth protecting: one fraud report slashes its bond and stains the record, so running a thousand sybils costs a thousand bonds and still buys no history.
